meta.title: BipAgents — AI agents that act for you, in Europe
meta.description: BipAgents gives you your own AI agents, the Bips: they book, sort your email, keep your calendar and your Notebook, and ask before they act. All included in your own space in Europe, no ads, no tracking. Built on Hermes Agent.

hero.lede: Write, talk, or go Live: your Bips book things, sort your email, keep your calendar and your Notebook, and always ask before they act. Everything included, in your own space in Europe, which we don’t read.

day.title: They take care of the rest.
day.sub: From morning coffee to dinner, here’s what your agents do for you, and what stays in your hands.

s1.title: Your morning briefing, as a podcast
s1.text: Appointments, weather, parcels: your agent writes up your day, and two voices read it to you over coffee.

s2.title: Email sorted, calendar kept
s2.text: It reads your inbox, pulls out what matters and notes appointments. It drafts replies: you read them before anything is sent.
s2.head: 3 important emails out of 41
s2.rest: 38 others: newsletters and deals, filed away
s2.agenda: Added to your calendar: school trip, Thursday 8 am

s3.text: People, subjects, tasks, trips, purchases and warranties: your agents keep your Notebook up to date, and you read it like a real notebook.
s3.title: Trip to Japan
s3.status: flights booked, Kyoto hotel to pick

s4.title: It browses, you watch
s4.text: Each agent has its own browser. Watch it fill in a form live, and take over whenever you like: a password, a captcha, a doubt.

s5.text: Booking, paying, sending: before anything sensitive, it asks. Once, for the session, or no, with one tap, even from the notification.
s5.head: Daily is asking
s5.title: Send the booking in your name?

s6.text: A long piece of research? It runs it in the background, never over the budget you set, and lets you know when it’s ready.

s6.done: I’ll let you know when it’s ready

s7.title: As a family

bips.title: One Bip per agent.
bips.sub: In the app, every agent is a little mascot with its colour and its mood: you know at a glance who’s talking. Go on, poke them: they react just like in the app.

compare.title: Yours. Not everyone’s.
compare.a11y: A usual assistant: your messages go to the company’s servers, with everyone’s conversations, and may be used to train its AI. BipAgents: your messages go to your space, yours alone; the AI reads them to answer you; Kerfy Studio keeps your account and your subscription, not your conversations.
compare.kerfy: your account and subscription, not your conversations
compare.line1: Your conversations and your agents’ memory live in your space, separate from everyone else’s.
compare.line2: We don’t read them and we train no AI with them. The AI reads them only to answer you.
compare.line3: We keep your account, not your conversations. You can take everything and leave.
compare.note: “A usual assistant”: what the consumer offers of assistants such as ChatGPT or Gemini do by default, according to their own pages in October 2026. On the all-included offer, Kerfy Studio rents your space’s server: we don’t read it, but we don’t promise the impossible.
compare.more: The comparison, its sources and our limits →
compare.sub: Your agents know your life. It stays in your space, in Europe.
compare.line0: Your space is on a server in Europe, at OVHcloud or Hetzner, or on your own computer.

install.windows: On Windows 11, in PowerShell run as administrator:

1.a: Your own AI agents, the Bips, in the app on iPhone, iPad and Android. They work in your own space, on a server in Europe that we look after: nothing to install, nothing to set up, updates and backups included.

2.a: Often: a week to start, while there are some left this month and if you never had one. We tell you before you pay whether it applies, when it ends and the price that follows. Stop before it ends and nothing is charged.

3.a: Each person gets €0.50 of AI credit a month, counted at the chosen model’s price; the app shows it as an estimated number of messages. What’s left carries over to the next month. Need more: €2 of credit for €2.99 in the app, and it never expires. Out of credit: your agents take a break until next month, nothing is lost.

4.a: Not us: Kerfy Studio doesn’t read them or train any AI on them. To answer you, the AI reads what your agent sends it: through EUrouter, a European AI router, then the company running the chosen model, which the app names before your first message. As we rent the server, we could technically enter your space: our software doesn’t, and we only would if the law required it.

5.q: How do Duo and Family work?
5.a: Each invited person has their own account, space, agents and AI credit. Neither the person who pays nor we read anyone else’s. With Family, up to six people share a server that’s yours alone.

6.q: Can I stop whenever I want?
6.a: Yes, at no cost: the subscription ends at the end of the paid period. Your space is then kept for 30 days so you can take everything with you, then erased with its backups. And you have 14 days to change your mind after buying.

7.q: Why is it cheaper on the web?
7.a: In the app, the App Store and Google Play take a commission. On the web it’s smaller, so we pass it on to you. Same service: you sign in to the app with the same account.

8.a: Both, and iPad too: iOS 18 or later, Android 10 or later. In English, French, German and Spanish.

9.a: Nous Research’s open-source AI agent. BipAgents is an independent app built on it: it turns your Hermes agents into Bips you take everywhere.

10.a: The app is free: one command installs it on your computer or server, and you only pay for the AI model you pick. The subscription spares you all that.
